scope: Every frontend src/**/*.ts and src/**/*.tsx, including declaration files; Vite build configuration. CSS and tests are outside the function catalog.
method: Read complete runtime bodies and module-level contracts. TypeScript AST records every function with a body, including nested arrows, callbacks, methods and accessors, and top-level symbols. Anonymous names use source locations; hashes bind the review to exact source. This is scoped source review, not coverage or proof of correctness.
